$Comment: The Christmas Coat, the chest piece of the Christmas Set (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Set.json), sold at Elsie the Weaver's Christmas stall once a player is Santa's Favorite. A full item body with no Parent, so it inherits no recipe and nobody crafts it: it wears the game's own cotton tunic (Armor_Cloth_Cotton_Chest's model, texture, icon and armour numbers). Its own stats ride the native Armor block: the cotton tunic's resistances plus 5% less Ice damage, Health and Stamina like any armour, and ReputationGain_Christmas_Nice_List (10 is +10%), which raises every gain of Santa's favor while it is worn. Raise or lower an Amount to tune it; the set adds its own bonus on top.
